title: 82nd Airborne Division War Memorial Museum
scope: Exterior of the public 82nd Airborne Division War Memorial Museum, the permanent 1957 museum and its attached additions at 5108 Ardennes Street.
limitations: The named footprint and state roofline establish the plan. Undocumented wall heights, cladding, service-side openings and roof profiles are approximations.
This exterior represents the public museum building. It excludes the exhibits, memorials, aircraft, campus circulation and other structures.
